newsitem.title: USA: USWA files Precision Castparts objections.
newsitem.headline: USWA files Precision Castparts objections.

text.p: The United Steelworkers of America (USWA) said it filed 32 objections with the National Labor Relations Board (NLRB) regarding Precision Castparts Corp's conduct in a representation election.
The union said that, while last week's vote went against the union, the violations Precision were so egregious the Labor Relations Board is certain to overturn results.
Precision was not immediately available for comment.
The union said Precision management interrogated, intimidated, coerced and threatened employees.

It said Precision employees encountered a similar problem in July 1995, the USWA said. The NLRB overturned the representation election held then because of Precision management's illegal conduct during that campaign, the union said.
The union said David J. Burkes and Associates of Malibu, Calif., acted as consultant to Precision. Company officials at the consulting firm were unavailable.
